- [USER] User expressed interest in how companies adjust their strategies to maintain profitability in the face of declining revenue.

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Cutting Costs - Companies can reduce expenses in areas such as marketing, sales, research and development, and general operations.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Diversification - Companies can diversify their product or service offerings to establish new revenue streams and protect against market fluctuations.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Innovative Marketing - Companies can adjust their marketing strategy to reach a wider or different audience to increase sales.
